title: A nonzero grouped extension coefficient
statement: Let $\ell>0$, and let $\gamma$ be a nonzero binary string of length $n\ell$, viewed as $n$ consecutive blocks of length $\ell$. At least one block, interpreted through a fixed basis of the degree-$\ell$ binary extension field, represents a nonzero field element.
